description: This file contains a PHP function 'get_body' which generates dynamic form elements (such as dropdowns and radio buttons) for custom fields in the SuiteCRM application. It includes logic for handling multienum types, default options, module language strings, and integrating with template rendering. The file is part of the module for configuring enum fields in the user interface.

methods.name: get_body
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript necessary to display and manage a dynamic dropdown or radio button list for enum field configuration in the SuiteCRM custom field editor.
